caption:
True or False? 🤔

"A credit freeze lowers your credit score."

Tell us what you think before you read the answer.

False. A freeze doesn't touch your score. It just blocks new lenders from opening accounts in your name.

Did you get this one right?

instagram.first_comment: Vote true or false. @creditscoretruths will share the answer in the post.
